ceo_title_big: Creating unique value through superior engineering.
ceo_desc:
The new “Soltec Engineering Vietnam” has officially commenced operations.

Formerly known as KOBELCO E&M VIETNAM CO., LTD., the company underwent a capital transfer in December 2025. Building upon our past business foundation, we have re-established our manufacturing base in Vietnam and are committed to delivering high value-added products in a timely manner through our advanced manufacturing capabilities. In addition, we have obtained globally recognized fabrication licenses to meet the expectations of our customers worldwide.

In addition to the design and fabrication of towers, vessels, heat exchangers, and various industrial equipment, we also provide comprehensive services ranging from on-site installation to maintenance. Leveraging our proven track record, we will continue striving to meet customer needs based on QCDS (Quality, Cost, Delivery, Safety).

Furthermore, as a member of the Soltec Group, we will maximize group synergies through collaboration with our headquarters in Japan, Soltec Vietnam, and affiliated companies such as Rutenchem, thereby delivering integrated capabilities and enhanced value to our customers.

Not only in Japan, but also across ASEAN and other global markets, we aim to provide high value-added products promptly through our superior manufacturing expertise.

All employees are committed to working together with full dedication. We sincerely appreciate your continued support and look forward to your expectations.
team_desc_1:
At SEV (Soltec Engineering Vietnam), we provide a professional and transparent working environment based on responsibility and Japanese standards.

We welcome individuals at all stages — from young engineers seeking their first challenges to experienced professionals looking to contribute their expertise in a stable and structured environment.

If you are ready to grow, contribute, and build a long-term career, SEV is ready to welcome you.

process_quote: Bring us your engineering challenge — SEV will build the solution.
desc_process_1:
Utilizing PV Elite for seismic and structural analysis and HTRI for thermal design analysis, SEV provides optimized engineering solutions with consideration for manufacturability, safety, and operational efficiency.
Our extensive experience and technical expertise enable us to support a wide range of industrial sectors.
desc_process_2:
Led by highly experienced engineers and technicians with 15–29 years of expertise, SEV delivers high-quality and high-precision fabrication through its fully integrated in-house production system.
SEV also possesses 29 highly skilled welders capable of handling special materials such as Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Duplex, Hastelloy, Titanium, Nickel, and Aluminum.
desc_process_3:
Comprehensive in-house Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) capabilities including RT, UT, PT, MT, and Videoscope inspection ensure fast and strict quality control without relying on external inspection services.
SEV operates under strict ITP-based quality management and has extensive experience coordinating with international third-party inspection agencies such as TÜV, BV, SGS, LRQA, and Apave.
desc_process_4:
From installation and commissioning to repair and maintenance, SEV provides total lifecycle support.
Beyond standard repair services, we proactively analyze root causes, propose improvement solutions, and optimize equipment performance to enhance operational stability and equipment lifespan.
process_end: By optimizing quality, cost, and delivery, SEV delivers high value-added solutions from engineering design to after-sales technical support.
